name: Ayşe Demir
bio:
Ayşe's fascination with motorsport began during her university years, fueled by late-night streams of Formula 1 races. She pursued a degree in Materials Engineering, focusing her thesis on advanced composite materials used in race car construction. After graduating, she secured an apprenticeship with a small, independent racing team, quickly proving her aptitude for composite repair and design. Her meticulous attention to detail and ability to troubleshoot complex problems caught the eye of Tolman Motorsport, where she now plays a crucial role in ensuring the structural integrity and aerodynamic efficiency of their vehicles.

Ayşe thrives under pressure, approaching each challenge with a calm and methodical demeanor. She is known for her ability to quickly diagnose and repair composite damage, often devising innovative solutions to improve the durability and performance of the components she works on. Her team-oriented approach and willingness to share her knowledge make her a valuable asset to Tolman Motorsport, where she continues to push the boundaries of composite technology in the pursuit of racing excellence.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Ayşe is of average height with a lean build, often seen wearing safety glasses and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and potential design improvements.
Has a habit of tapping her fingers on surfaces while deep in thought.
Insists on using a specific brand of precision calipers for all her measurements.
